events.detail_full_en: Due to the effects of heavy rain, a suspension of services is in place between Kooriyama and Aizuwakamatsu stations, between Kitakata and Yamato stations, and between Tsugawa and Mashita stations. For the Kooriyama-Aizuwakamatsu and Tsugawa-Mashita sections, services will remain suspended for the entire day. Some trains on the operating sections are experiencing delays or service suspensions.
